title: Quantum Gravity
description: Gravitons and spin foam: spacetime made of quanta. Unlocks the Graviton Condenser.

puzzle.goal: In a quantum theory of geometry, a surface's area is not continuous: every edge of a spin network that pierces it adds a quantum of area set by its spin j. Write the total area of a surface pierced N times, in terms of the fundamental constants and a free dimensionless parameter γ.
puzzle.name: Loop quantum gravity area spectrum
puzzle.form: 8 * π * γ * ħ * G / c ^ 3 * sum ( n , 1 , N , sqrt ( j _ n * ( j _ n + 1 ) ) )
puzzle.expr: 8 * π * γ * N * sqrt ( j * ( j + 1 ) )
puzzle.ask: Find the area, in units of ħG/c³, of a surface pierced N times by spin-½ edges.
puzzle.method: The area operator is diagonal on spin networks; each puncture contributes the square root of the Casimir j(j+1) of its spin, times 8πγ in Planck area units.
